ValidationRule.description: Validates that the required information has been captured before resolving or closing a complaint.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT( ISNEW() ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Complaint_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close the case, complaint outcome and description of outcome must be populated. To resolve the case, complaint outcome, description of outcome and complaint remedy must be populated.
